title: docs: the four-doors table in validating-metadata.mdx under-reports the reference-integrity row and has no row for the list-view sort/search members
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC

Filing gate: ② doc sentence made stale by earlier merges, from the contract review of PR #30564 (#30095), record 6663292380, should-fix S1. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3. Docs only.

Business reason: an author reads the four-doors table to learn which publish door refuses what. Two rows tell them less than the doors do, so they think a door passes a write that it refuses.

## What happens

1. **Reference-integrity row is stale.** In `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, the row "Flow reference integrity — node writes, template paths, read-only writes (#3583)" marks the fourth door `✓ᶠ` (flow only). The rule entry `validateReferenceIntegrity` in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` has carried `runtimeTypes: ['flow','view','object','dataset','report','page']` since #9313 / #15254 / #19542 / #30023. The table's own legend says that a rule's `runtimeTypes` is the authority, so the row contradicts the legend. This was already stale before PR #30564; that PR does not change it.
2. **No row for the list-view field members.** The members `validateSortableFields`, `validateSearchableFields` and the list-view field-reference members run under that entry at the `view`, `page` and (after PR #30564) `object` doors. The table has no row that names them, so a reader cannot see that a list-view sort on a `sortable: false` field is refused at publish. The #30270 record noted the same gap.

## Ask

Re-spell the fourth-door cell of the reference-integrity row from the entry's real `runtimeTypes`, using the legend's superscripts. Add one row for the list-view sort / search / field-reference members with the doors that run them. Derive both from `AUTHORING_RULES` and the `DEFAULT_MEMBER_RUNTIME_TYPES` notes in `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`, not from memory. `Skills-docs: updated here`.

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (docs), `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`.

Dedupe: `validating-metadata.mdx table`, `four doors table runtimeTypes`, `validating-metadata reference integrity row`. **New.**
